system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The rollout is initialized with a predefined system prompt and the question
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt-building mechanism described. Coded per paper-only rule. The evidence bundle also contains arXiv:2509.05651 (a different maze-solving 'Orchestrator' MAS); coding follows 2511.21689, which introduces Orchestrator-8B.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Orchestrator selects a tool from the available set (e.g., APIs, specialized models, code interpreters) and specifies parameters
env_context_strategy.note: Context is obtained via model-invoked tools (web search, Faiss local search). Local search is embedding retrieval, but it is exposed as a tool the model calls, not injected into the prompt.

context_compaction.note: No repository or config surface is in the evidence; the paper does not describe history handling.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the resulting output is appended to the context under the user role and fed back to the model for the next turn

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: If a tool call is present, the tool-call block is extracted and executed by the environment
tool_call_format.note: Tools are specified in JSON (Sec. 3.1). The call syntax is inferred as a JSON block in the text; the parser is not shown.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is in the evidence. The evaluation set (Sec. 4.1) lists basic tools plus about 9 models, but domain functions vary, so no exact count is possible.

edit_primitive.note: No tool registry is in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Tools are specified in JSON as a list of objects; each object defines the tool name, description, and a typed parameter schema
tool_schema_source.note: Descriptions of LLM tools are written by another LLM from trajectories. auto_generated is the closest value but does not fit exactly (generated by a model, not derived from code types).

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependencies are available to grep.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The Orchestrator analyzes the current state and plans the next action.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: By delegating narrowed-down sub-problems of a larger effort requiring intelligence to intelligent tools instead of handling the entire effort by a single generalist
multi_agent_topology.note: The workers are LLMs invoked as tools, possibly single calls rather than full agents; `single` is arguable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: models of various capabilities are made available to the orchestrator asintelligent tools
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: delegation is a tool call to another LLM, not an explicit agent/conversation object.

human_in_loop.note: No run loop or config is in the evidence.

long_term_memory.note: No code is in the evidence.

state_persistence.note: No code is in the evidence.

self_verification.note: The GPT-5 judge is used only for the training reward (Sec. 3.2), not at inference.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This process repeats until Orchestrator receives a termination signal from the environment or the rollout reaches a maximum of 50 turns.
termination_condition.note: Also ends on an environment termination signal (unspecified).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the challenge for the orchestrator is then to dynamically decide on which tools to invoke in order to solve the task while respecting user preferences for various tools and minimizing the cost
cost_controls.note: Routing is a learned policy of the RL-trained model, not a harness router.

execution_isolation.note: The paper mentions a 'Python sandbox for Code interpreter' (Sec. 4.1) without describing its mechanism; no deployment config is in the evidence.

eval_hooks.note: No repository is in the evidence; the paper evaluates on HLE, FRAMES and tau2-Bench.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We conduct experiments on three popular benchmarks with complex reasoning:Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE),FRAMES, and 𝜏 2-Bench.

open_source.note: The paper links 'Code Model Data', but no repository or licence is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We employ Qwen3-8B as the backbone LLM
model_agnostic.note: The orchestrator is a specific RL-trained model; the models it calls as tools are heterogeneous across providers.

primary_artifact.note: No repository was provided in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date (fallback rule); no tags available.
